calibration: All available matching M4 episodes, pooled without success/task/seed labels; no parameter search
aggregation: Both changes and disagreements: per two-step window, same absolute steps
consumed_prefix: excluded offline and online; handoff history never supplies new-cue changes
experimental_change: Frozen v3 plus one pre-event observation renewal when an already covered cue uses an image more than16 action steps old. Existing Full/Fast quality, no-consecutive-Fast and HIGH event compute remain; use selected service to schedule, skip if already timely or too late.
